mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET STATUS = 'SHIPPED' WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE ORDERS SET STATUS = 'CANCELED' WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, OI.ITEM_ID AS itemId, P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS orderDate, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, OI.QUANTITY AS quantity, OI.UNIT_PRICE AS price, ROUND(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE, 2) AS totalPrice FROM CUSTOMERS C, ORDERS O, ORDER_ITEMS OI, PRODUCTS P WHERE UPPER(TRIM(C.NAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{name})) AND O.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID AND O.STATUS = 'SHIPPED' AND O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID AND OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY O.ORDER_ID, OI.ITEM_ID

WITH MONTHS AS ( SELECT LPAD(LEVEL, 2, '0') AS month FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ), ORDER_SUM AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM') AS month, SUM(OI.QUANTITY) AS quantity FROM CUSTOMERS C, ORDERS O, ORDER_ITEMS OI WHERE UPPER(TRIM(C.NAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{name})) AND C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID AND O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID AND O.STATUS = 'SHIPPED' AND TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM') ) SELECT #{year} AS year, M.month AS month, NVL(OS.quantity, 0) AS quantity FROM MONTHS M, ORDER_SUM OS WHERE M.month = OS.month(+) ORDER BY M.month
